description: A 32x32 magenta source with `fit: native` on an upper track, over a full-frame red bed, in a 64x64 raster. Native scales nothing, so the reference is a 32x32 magenta square resting exactly in the middle of the frame with the red bed all around it. Three things fail here: scaling the small source up to the raster (the frame goes all magenta, which is what every clip did before fit modes existed), resting it anywhere but the centre, and covering the area outside it — the bed showing through is what makes a native layer an overlay rather than a card.
